description: The pie chart represents the distribution of narrative media framing across various news sources. There are 20 slices, each corresponding to a different news source, with the following approximate proportions: The Daily Caller (8%), The Huffington Post (7%), NPR (6%), Vox (6%), The Guardian (5%), BBC (5%), RT (4%), Daily Kos (3%), National Review (3%), Daily Mail (3%), Fox News (3%), CNN (3%), Red State (3%), PoliticusUSA (3%), Shareblue (3%), and Other (13%). The chart includes percentage labels inside the slices and a legend is not present. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
